assert: R1 five-of-five parity: the real Redis adapter and the reference store give the same decisions for 6 sequential distinct subjects
R1b WATCH parity: 4 distinct subjects + a repeat is denied on real Redis too (the 4/5 WATCH counts requests)
R1c trusted advisory on real Redis: the trusted 5th subject is allowed, the K1 block it triggered denies the next untrusted subject
R2 the three spray sets exist on Redis (cardinality 4..5), every Redis key has a TTL, no spray set exceeds the fixed 600 s window or 5 members
R3 negative control: all 128 concurrent workers completed
R3 atomic cap under concurrency: in every round exactly 4 of 16 simultaneous distinct subjects are allowed (never 5+), each of the 8 spray sets holds exactly 5 members with a TTL <= 600
R4 negative control: all 72 concurrent workers completed
R4 one subject is one member: 12 simultaneous requests of the SAME subject are all allowed (no inflated distinct count)
R5 rotation on real Redis: 3 subjects under the previous secret + 2 under the new one deny the 5th distinct subject (previous set read, bridge written)
R5 a subject already in the previous set is not double counted across rotation: 4 + one repeat gives the same WATCH denial as without rotation
R5 after rotation every Redis key still has a TTL; the current-generation spray sets exist (bridge cardinality <= 5) with TTL <= 600
